name: Wei Jian Hao
bio:
Wei Jian Hao's journey into motorsport HR began unexpectedly. After graduating with a business degree from the National University of Singapore, he initially pursued a career in traditional corporate HR. However, a chance encounter with a former Formula 1 mechanic sparked his interest in the fast-paced world of racing. Intrigued by the unique challenges of managing talent in such a high-pressure environment, he transitioned into motorsport, eventually landing a role with Team Penske. He sees the HR department as vital, not just for hiring talent but also for nurturing a team environment where everyone can be their best. 

Wei believes in a data-driven approach to HR, leveraging analytics to identify areas for improvement in employee satisfaction and performance. He is a strong advocate for diversity and inclusion, striving to create a workplace where individuals from all backgrounds feel valued and respected. He's always looking for ways to attract and retain top talent, ensuring Team Penske remains competitive both on and off the track. His experience in both traditional and motorsport HR gives him a unique perspective when it comes to understanding the needs of the team and its staff, and he is dedicated to fostering a culture of growth and development within the organization.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave.
physical.description: Wei is of average height with a lean build and often wears smart-casual attire.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when concentrating.
Starts every morning with a cup of teh tarik (pulled tea).
